name: Audius Governance proxy re-initialization
summary: AudiusAdminUpgradeabilityProxy declares `address private proxyAdmin` in ordinary storage slot 0, while the delegated Governance logic inherits OpenZeppelin's Initializable, whose `bool private initialized` and `bool private initializing` are packed into byte 0 and byte 1 of the same slot 0. The Governance proxy's admin is its own address 0x4deca517d6817b6510798b7328f2314d3003abac, so byte 1 reads 0xab and `initializing` is permanently true. The `initializer` modifier's guard `require(initializing || isConstructor() || !initialized)` therefore always passes and, because `isTopLevelCall = !initializing` is false, never re-arms. Governance.initialize(address,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint16,address) stayed callable by anyone for the life of the deployed proxy; the attacker re-ran it to install himself as guardian, then submitted and evaluated his own proposal, which moved the community treasury's AUDIO balance out.
notes: The Governance proxy was created with implementation 0x35dd16dfa4ea1522c29ddd087e8f076cad0ae5e8 selected in its constructor, which is the moment the defect-bearing artifact became active for this execution context. The implementation contract itself was created two blocks earlier in 0x8776e874401ca138c391d835a079f153348157963d76c77f3ebcbe164d196100. No Upgraded(address) event was ever emitted by the proxy before the exploit, and the EIP-1967 implementation slot still held 0x35dd16... at block 15201735.

Proposal 85 moved exactly 18564497.819999999999735541 AUDIO from the Governance/community treasury 0x4deca517d6817b6510798b7328f2314d3003abac to the attacker helper in 0x4227bca8ed4b8915c7eec0e14ad3748a88c4371d4176e716e8007249b9980dc9 (log 0x2b). Twenty-seven seconds later the attacker swapped the entire position through the single Uniswap V2 AUDIO/WETH pair 0xc730ef0f4973da9cc0ab8ab291890d3e77f58f79 and received 704.177543861243828018 ETH in 0x82fc23992c7433fffad0e28a1b8d11211dc4377de83e88088d79f24f4a3f28b3. That one swap took AUDIO from a 0.3667 USD spot mark to a realised 0.0588 USD per token, so the realised ETH proceeds are used as the valuation, priced at the DefiLlama ETH observation nearest the sale. Spot-marking the 18.56M AUDIO would imply 6.8M USD, a price at which the quantity could not have been sold. Nothing was recovered. Gas and the attacker's earlier failed proposals do not adjust the depletion.

The same anchor transaction also re-initialized the Registry proxy 0xe6d97b2099f142513be7a2a068be040656ae4591 and the Staking proxy 0x4d7968ebfd390d5e7926cb3587c39eff2f9fb225, which are deployed behind the same AudiusAdminUpgradeabilityProxy pattern. They are separate implementations and no loss is attributed to them, so they are recorded here as context rather than as additional targets.
